name: Leek
description: Mild sweet allium, sweated down as the base of soups.

tcm.note: The cong family is warm and disperses cold — the classic first-sign-of-a-chill vegetable.

ayurveda.note: Ushna like the rest of the onion family, if gentler.

unani.note: Kurrath is garam-khushk in the Unani record.
